Aegis.name: Protector's Strike
Aegis.description: Protect allies from the next incoming attack against them, and lash out when attacked, granting boons to nearby allies and fully charging the passive burning effect.

Aegis.name: Shield of Judgment
Aegis.description: Create a shielding wave in front of you that damages foes while giving protection and aegis to you and up to five allies.

Aegis.name: Virtue of Courage
Aegis.description: Virtue: Gain aegis periodically. Activate: Grant aegis to yourself and nearby allies.

Aegis.name: "Advance!"
Aegis.description: Shout. Grant aegis and swiftness to up to five nearby allies.

Aegis.name: Fragments of Faith
Aegis.description: Trap. Lay a trap that deals damage and unleashes multiple fragments into the area when triggered. Each fragment grants aegis to allies, as long as they don't already have aegis.

Aegis.name: Stalwart Stance
Aegis.description: Stance. Break stun for nearby allies and enter a defensive stance, taking reduced damage.

Aegis.name: Valorous Defense
Aegis.description: Gain aegis when you are struck while below the health threshold.

Aegis.name: Communal Defenses
Aegis.description: Blocking an attack grants aegis to nearby allies.

Aegis.name: Resolute Subconscious
Aegis.description: Gain resolution and aegis when disabled.Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Aegis.name: Shield of Courage
Aegis.description: Virtue. Grants aegis periodically. Activate: Grant aegis to nearby allies and create a shield in front of you that blocks attacks. You are vulnerable from the sides and behind while this shield is active.

Aegis.name: Hunter's Premonition
Aegis.description: Trap skills grant aegis when used.

Aegis.name: Tome of Courage
Aegis.description: Virtue: Gain aegis periodically.  Activate: Conjure a mystic tome containing stories about the heroes of Istan.

Aegis.name: Crashing Courage
Aegis.description: Virtue. Shadowstep a short distance while gaining boons and emanating Willbender Flames from your location. Gain courage.

Aegis.name: Gunstinger
Aegis.description: Quickly step forward to strike your foe while reloading your gun. Restores ammo to skill 5.

Aegis.name: Line Breaker
Aegis.description: Charge to the target location. When you arrive, heal nearby allies and grant them boons while debilitating nearby enemies.

Aegis.name: Banner of Defense
Aegis.description: Banner. Place a banner that grants barrier and boons on initial placement, then pulses additional boons to you and nearby allies afterward.

Aegis.name: Sundering Leap
Aegis.description: Rage. Leap to a location, dealing damage and inflicting conditions on all foes in the area. Extends the duration of berserk mode if it hits.

Aegis.name: "Never Surrender!"
Aegis.description: Command. Break stun while granting boons to nearby allies. The cooldown of this skill is increased if used to break a stun. Echo. Grant additional boons to nearby allies after a set interval or after you use a burst skill.

Aegis.name: Field of the Mists
Aegis.description: Create a field from the Mists that blocks incoming projectiles in front of you, then fire bolts at foes around your target.

Aegis.name: Envoy of Exuberance
Aegis.description: Send the energy of Glint toward the target area, releasing a burst of energy that heals allies and grants boons.

Aegis.name: "We Heal As One!"
Aegis.description: Command. Heal yourself and your pet. You each gain copies of the other's boons.

Aegis.name: Stone Spirit
Aegis.description: Spirit. Summon a stone spirit at a target location and apply aegis to nearby allies. The spirit will slam the ground and then shake, granting boons to nearby allies.

Aegis.name: Wind Shear
Aegis.description: Squall. Wind swells around you, knocking back nearby enemies and reflecting incoming projectiles.

Aegis.name: Fortifying Bond
Aegis.description: When you gain a boon, it is shared with your pet.

Aegis.name: Fresh Reinforcement
Aegis.description: Entering beastmode grants you the boons affecting your pet.

Aegis.name: Consume Plasma
Aegis.description: Gain all boons.

Aegis.name: Essence of Liquid Wrath
Aegis.description: Fire a volley of arrows equipped with a payload that spreads magical flames across the ground on impact, granting boons to allies on the initial detonation and leaving a fire field.  Chain Reaction. The next short-bow skill in the radius will grant an additional boon to allies.

Aegis.name: Crisis Zone
Aegis.description: Mech Command. Your mech removes conditions, breaks stuns, and grants boons to itself and nearby allies.  The mech does not count against the target count for this skill.

Aegis.name: Rejuvenate
Aegis.description: Meditation. Heal yourself and charge your familiar skill.

Aegis.name: Armor of Earth
Aegis.description: Cantrip. Protect yourself with earth armor and gain protection and stability, then gain barrier for each unique boon you have.

Aegis.name: "Aftershock!"
Aegis.description: Shout. Call upon the earth to cripple and immobilize foes in the area around you. Allies in the initial blast gain a magnetic aura.

Aegis.name: Chaos Storm
Aegis.description: Create a magical storm at the target location that applies random conditions to foes and boons to allies. The first strike of the storm dazes foes.

Aegis.name: Twin Blade Restoration
Aegis.description: Psionic. Heal yourself, lose conditions, and throw two blades at your target. If the first blade hits, you gain aegis. If the second blade hits, you gain vigor.

Aegis.name: Signet of Inspiration
Aegis.description: Signet Passive: Grant swiftness and an additional random boon every ten seconds. Signet Active: Extends the duration of all boons on yourself.

Aegis.name: Mantra of Concentration
Aegis.description: Mantra. Meditate, charging a spell that will break stuns and grant stability to nearby allies. Grant boons to nearby allies when this spell fully charges.

Aegis.name: Well of Precognition
Aegis.description: Well. Create a well that gives allies the ability to see the future, allowing them to block incoming attacks. When the well ends, allies within the well regain endurance.

Aegis.name: Master of Manipulation
Aegis.description: Manipulations grant aegis to yourself and nearby allies.

Aegis.name: Inspiring Distortion
Aegis.description: Grant aegis to other nearby allies whenever you give yourself distortion or use Shatter skill 4.

Aegis.name: Bladeturn Refrain
Aegis.description: Bladesongs grant aegis.

Aegis.name: Serpent Siphon
Aegis.description: Punishment. Unleash a ghostly serpent toward a targeted area. Upon arriving, the serpent will burst into sand, granting barrier and boons to nearby allies and poisoning enemies. Convert a boon from struck enemies into torment.

Alacrity.name: Phoenix Protocol
Alacrity.description: Gain boons when resolve's effect triggers, but you no longer heal. Resolve has a modified duration. Gain boons when you use Flowing Resolve.

Alacrity.name: Daring Dragon
Alacrity.description: Dragon Slash has a lower maximum charge level and consumes more flow per charge, but its effectiveness per charge is increased. Grant boons to nearby allies when you use Dragon Slash.

Alacrity.name: Feverish Pulse
Alacrity.description: Using a chant reduces the recharge of your other chants and grants boons to affected allies.

Alacrity.name: Orders from Above
Alacrity.description: Citadel Order. Orders from above arrive, renewing your abilities and those of your nearby allies.

Alacrity.name: Saint's Shield
Alacrity.description: Drop from above, granting barrier and healing to allies in the affected area.

Alacrity.name: "We Heal As One!"
Alacrity.description: Command. Heal yourself and your pet. You each gain copies of the other's boons.

Alacrity.name: Fortifying Bond
Alacrity.description: When you gain a boon, it is shared with your pet.

Alacrity.name: Grace of the Land
Alacrity.description: Grant boons to allies within the radius of your Celestial Avatar skills.

Alacrity.name: Fresh Reinforcement
Alacrity.description: Entering beastmode grants you the boons affecting your pet.

Alacrity.name: Consume Plasma
Alacrity.description: Gain all boons.

Alacrity.name: Possessive Hoarder
Alacrity.description: Artifacts grant boons to allies when used. Offensive and defensive artifacts grant different boons. Barrier granted through Magpie's Defense and Enterprising Aristocrat is now also granted to allies as well.

Alacrity.name: Crisis Zone
Alacrity.description: Mech Command. Your mech removes conditions, breaks stuns, and grants boons to itself and nearby allies.  The mech does not count against the target count for this skill.

Alacrity.name: Mech Frame: Channeling Conduits
Alacrity.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Crisis Zone. When you or your mech apply barrier, also grant a boon to the affected target. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own concentration and healing power stats.

Alacrity.name: New Genes
Alacrity.description: Morph skills grant boons to allies. Grant an additional boon based on which morph skill was used.

Alacrity.name: Lucid Singularity
Alacrity.description: Apply boons to nearby allies while channeling overloads and when successfully completing an overload channel.

Alacrity.name: Elemental Bastion
Alacrity.description: Heal allies you grant an aura to. Grant frost aura to nearby allies when struck while below the health threshold.

Alacrity.name: Signet of Inspiration
Alacrity.description: Signet Passive: Grant swiftness and an additional random boon every ten seconds. Signet Active: Extends the duration of all boons on yourself.

Alacrity.name: Flow of Time
Alacrity.description: Gain alacrity for each clone you shatter. Gain increased critical-strike chance for you and your illusions when you have alacrity.

Alacrity.name: Illusionary Reversion
Alacrity.description: Shatter skills generate a clone and grant alacrity if you have enough clones present.

Alacrity.name: Stretched Time
Alacrity.description: Nearby allies gain boons for each clone you shatter. Grant boons to nearby allies when you summon a phantasm.

Alacrity.name: Mirage Mantle
Alacrity.description: Ambush skills you use grant boons to nearby allies.

Alacrity.name: Desert Empowerment
Alacrity.description: Manifest Sand Shade grants a barrier to allies near it. When you apply barrier, grant boons to the affected target.This effect only occurs with barrier from scourge skills and traits.

Fury.name: Symbol of Vengeance
Fury.description: Symbol. Cleave your axe into the ground, reducing enemy movement and carving a razor-sharp symbol of vengeance.

Fury.name: Gleaming Disc
Fury.description: Spin around, striking enemies around you. After a short delay, a shock wave of light bursts forth from your position, damaging enemies and granting might to allies. Your next spear attack is illuminated when striking an enemy with the initial spin.   Illuminated. The shock wave additionally deals more damage and inflicts conditions on enemies and grants boons to allies.

Fury.name: Symbol of Spears
Fury.description: Symbol. Create a spear wall in front of you that damages foes that remain in its area.

Fury.name: Symbol of Blades
Fury.description: Symbol. Teleport to your target, and blind nearby foes. Create a symbol at your feet that damages nearby enemies and benefits allies.

Fury.name: "Save Yourselves!"
Fury.description: Shout. Draw conditions from nearby allies to yourself. Gain multiple boons for a short duration.

Fury.name: Procession of Blades
Fury.description: Trap. Set a trap that whirls around and damages enemies when activated.

Fury.name: "Feel My Wrath!"
Fury.description: Shout. Grant fury and quickness to nearby allies. The duration of the quickness you grant yourself is doubled.

Fury.name: Wrathful Spirit
Fury.description: Aegis grants boons when it ends.

Fury.name: Inner Fire
Fury.description: Gain fury when you strike a foe that has burning stacks over the threshold.

Fury.name: Monk's Focus
Fury.description: Meditation skills heal you and grant fury to nearby allies.

Fury.name: Holy Reckoning
Fury.description: Triggered virtue effects now grant might to allies in addition to their bonuses. Gain fury when activating Rushing Justice.

Fury.name: Cyclone Axe
Fury.description: Spin around and attack all nearby foes, applying vulnerability each hit. Gain fury for each foe hit.

Fury.name: Arcing Slice
Fury.description: Burst. Deliver a circular attack to foes around you, and gain fury. Deal more damage to foes with low health.

Fury.name: Valiant Leap
Fury.description: Leap to the targeted location, empowering allies and damaging enemies. Gain adrenaline if you affect another ally.

Fury.name: Charge
Fury.description: Grant boons and remove movement-impairing conditions from allies.

Fury.name: Combat Stimulant
Fury.description: Armament. Heal yourself and enter Stim State. When Stim State expires, you are healed again. Using this skill while in Stim State grants boons.

Fury.name: "For Great Justice!"
Fury.description: Shout. Grant fury and might to yourself and allies.

Fury.name: Banner of Discipline
Fury.description: Banner. Place a banner that damages and applies conditions to foes on initial placement, then pulses additional boons to you and nearby allies afterward.

Fury.name: Wild Blow
Fury.description: Rage. Lash out with a critical attack that knocks down your foes. Extend the duration of berserk mode if this attack hits.

Fury.name: Flow Stabilizer
Fury.description: Armament. Increase flow rate and gain fury. If you already have fury, gain additional flow.

Fury.name: Battle Standard
Fury.description: Banner. Place a battle standard that revives fallen allies and finishes downed foes. Once placed, the banner periodically grants boons to allies.

Fury.name: Signet of Rage
Fury.description: Signet Passive: Grants adrenaline while in combat. Signet Active: Gain fury, might, and swiftness.

Fury.name: Brave Stride
Fury.description: Movement skills grant boons and adrenaline when used.

Fury.name: Furious Burst
Fury.description: Gain fury when you swap weapons. Fury gives an increased critical chance.

Fury.name: Opportunist
Fury.description: Gain fury and adrenaline when you immobilize or disable a foe.

Fury.name: Burst of Aggression
Fury.description: Gain a burst of speed when entering berserk mode.

Fury.name: Heat the Soul
Fury.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you hit an enemy with a Burst skill.

Fury.name: Daring Dragon
Fury.description: Dragon Slash has a lower maximum charge level and consumes more flow per charge, but its effectiveness per charge is increased. Grant boons to nearby allies when you use Dragon Slash.

Fury.name: Phantom's Onslaught
Fury.description: Rush toward your opponent, cleaving the area.

Fury.name: Deathstrike
Fury.description: Shadowstep to your foe and deliver a quick attack, then deliver a second devastating blow if it hits.

Fury.name: Riposting Shadows
Fury.description: Legendary Assassin. Dodge backward through the Mists. Remove movement-impairing conditions, and gain fury.

Fury.name: Facet of Darkness
Fury.description: Legendary Dragon. Facet. Place the Facet of Darkness on yourself to grant nearby allies fury every few seconds.

Fury.name: Scavenger Burst
Fury.description: Legendary Alliance. Unleash your rage at foes in the area, gaining boons and endurance for each foe struck.

Fury.name: Invoker's Rage
Fury.description: Gain fury when you invoke a legend.

Fury.name: Assassin's Presence
Fury.description: While you are in combat, grant fury to yourself and nearby allies each interval.

Fury.name: Endless Enmity
Fury.description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike a foe.

Fury.name: Feeding Frenzy
Fury.description: Drive piranhas into a feeding frenzy around your foe. Apply fury to your pet.

Fury.name: Call of the Wild
Fury.description: Daze and weaken nearby enemies. Grant fury, might, and swiftness to yourself and nearby allies.

Fury.name: "We Heal As One!"
Fury.description: Command. Heal yourself and your pet. You each gain copies of the other's boons.

Fury.name: Storm Spirit
Fury.description: Spirit. Summon a storm spirit at a target location and apply vulnerability to nearby enemies. The spirit will slam the ground and then shake, granting boons to nearby allies.

Fury.name: Moa Stance
Fury.description: Stance. Gain boons. Increase the duration of boons you grant while in this stance.

Fury.name: "Strength of the Pack!"
Fury.description: Command. Rampage with your pet, gaining stability, fury, and swiftness. You and your pet also grant might to each other when you attack.

Fury.name: Stoneform
Fury.description: Use Lesser Signet of Stone when you use an elite skill. Activating a Signet grants might and fury.

Fury.name: Furious Grip
Fury.description: Gain fury when swapping weapons in combat.

Fury.name: Fang and Claw
Fury.description: Feline, avian, and drake pets gain increased precision and ferocity. Beast skills grant fury around the ranger.

Fury.name: Vicious Quarry
Fury.description: Fury grants ferocity and additional increased critical strike chance. When struck while below the health threshold, gain fury.

Fury.name: Wilderness Knowledge
Fury.description: Survival skills grant fury and remove conditions.

Fury.name: Fortifying Bond
Fury.description: When you gain a boon, it is shared with your pet.

Fury.name: Spirited Arrival
Fury.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when swapping pets.

Fury.name: Bestial Rage
Fury.description: Gain might and fury when you disable a foe.

Fury.name: Fresh Reinforcement
Fury.description: Entering beastmode grants you the boons affecting your pet.

Fury.name: Live Fast
Fury.description: Using a Beast ability grants you offensive boons.

Fury.name: Hawkeye
Fury.description: Release a hail of arrows toward your target and enemies nearby them.

Fury.name: Consume Plasma
Fury.description: Gain all boons.

Fury.name: Haste
Fury.description: Trick. Gain quickness, fury, and swiftness.

Fury.name: Well of Bounty
Fury.description: Well. Shadowstep to a targeted point and create a well that grants boons to allies.

Fury.name: Unrelenting Strikes
Fury.description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike an enemy.

Fury.name: Sundering Shade
Fury.description: Stealth Attack skills inflict vulnerability and grant fury upon successfully hitting foes.

Fury.name: No Quarter
Fury.description: Landing a critical hit while under the effects of fury increases the duration of fury. Gain increased ferocity while under the effects of fury.

Fury.name: Thrill of the Crime
Fury.description: When you Steal, you and all nearby allies gain fury, might, and swiftness for 10 seconds.

Fury.name: Maleficent Seven
Fury.description: Increase the maximum malice-stack count. Restore initiative and gain boons upon reaching the maximum number of malice stacks.

Fury.name: Fire for Effect
Fury.description: Using a stolen skill grants additional boons to allies around you. Stolen skills will always be Steal Time, regardless of the target's profession.

Fury.name: Holo-Dancer Decoy
Fury.description: Defensive Artifact. Summon a holo-dancer decoy that taunts enemies and grants boons to nearby allies. It self-destructs if it is not destroyed, dealing damage to enemies in a large area and granting additional boons to allies.  For a short time after using this skill, the next utility skill you use has reduced cooldown.

Fury.name: Possessive Hoarder
Fury.description: Artifacts grant boons to allies when used. Offensive and defensive artifacts grant different boons. Barrier granted through Magpie's Defense and Enterprising Aristocrat is now also granted to allies as well.

Fury.name: Rifle Turret
Fury.description: Turret. Build a rifle turret that shoots at foes. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first placed, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

Fury.name: Elixir B
Fury.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir B to gain fury, might, resolution, and swiftness, then extend the duration of boons on yourself.

Fury.name: Hard Light Arena
Fury.description: Exceed. Create a holographic arena that grants you boons while inside of it. When activated above the heat threshold, the radius is increased and the user is granted barrier. Allies gain boons at reduced duration.

Fury.name: Short Fuse
Fury.description: Gain fury when you hit a foe with an Explosion.

Fury.name: Hematic Focus
Fury.description: Gain fury when you inflict bleeding on an enemy. Fury gives an increased critical-strike chance.

Fury.name: No Scope
Fury.description: Critical hits on foes within the range threshold have a chance to grant fury. Fury grants you ferocity.

Fury.name: Boiling Point
Fury.description: Gain fury when you gain might at or above the threshold.

Fury.name: HGH
Fury.description: Elixirs gain increased durations and grant might.

Fury.name: Kinetic Accelerators
Fury.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you successfully combo a field with a blast, leap, or whirl finisher. Your function gyro is now a blast finisher.Whirl finishers can only trigger this trait once per interval.

Fury.name: Barrier Burst
Fury.description: Mech Command. Pulse a barrier and boons to all nearby allies.  The mech does not count against the target count for this skill.

Fury.name: Convergence
Fury.description: Charge the air to shock foes around you after a short delay. Inflict weakness on enemies and gain fury for each foe struck.

Fury.name: Molten End
Fury.description: Slam your hammer into the ground, damaging nearby enemies. If this strikes a burning enemy, gain offensive boons.

Fury.name: Seethe
Fury.description: Gain boons. Your next spear skill deals increased damage.

Fury.name: Etching: Derecho
Fury.description: Etch a spell into the ground that summons an intense windstorm. Using a number of other skills within this etching completes the spell, unlocking its full potential.

Fury.name: Heat Sync
Fury.description: Give might and fury to yourself, then spread boons you have to allies.

Fury.name: Cleansing Fire
Fury.description: Cantrip. Cure conditions and burn foes. Gain might for each condition removed.

Fury.name: "Feel the Burn!"
Fury.description: Shout. Heat waves blast out from the player, causing damage and granting fire aura to allies.

Fury.name: Zephyr's Boon
Fury.description: Grant boons to allies you grant auras to.

Fury.name: Raging Storm
Fury.description: Critically striking a foe grants fury. Gain ferocity while under the effects of fury.

Fury.name: Arcane Prowess
Fury.description: Gain boons when you switch attunements.

Fury.name: Overload Air
Fury.description: Overload. Use your air magic to summon a nimbus that repeatedly strikes nearby enemies. When this ability is complete, imbue your allies with electricity and create a lingering static region that strikes enemies at the same interval. Using this skill causes the attunement to have a longer recharge.

Fury.name: Air Sphere
Fury.description: Throw your sphere, creating a combo field and granting boons to allies within range based on your active attunement.

Fury.name: Deploy Jade Sphere
Fury.description: Summon your jade sphere, creating a combo field and granting boons to allies in its radius based on its element.

Fury.name: Energized Elements
Fury.description: Gain energy and boons when you switch attunements. Energy can only be gained while in combat.

Fury.name: Inspiring Imagery
Fury.description: Throw an inspiring beacon to a target location. The beacon will explode after a short duration, granting boons to nearby allies. The beacon can be detonated early to heal allies and damage enemies.

Fury.name: Winds of Chaos
Fury.description: Bounce an orb of energy between foes and allies. The first hit applies torment, while subsequent hits to enemies apply confusion. Allies that the orb bounces to gain fury and might.

Fury.name: Diversion
Fury.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, dazing their targets. The shatter effect also occurs at your location.

Fury.name: Signet of Inspiration
Fury.description: Signet Passive: Grant swiftness and an additional random boon every ten seconds. Signet Active: Extends the duration of all boons on yourself.

Fury.name: Well of Action
Fury.description: Well. Create a well of delayed time, damaging and slowing foes. When the well expires, time snaps back, granting boons to allies.

Fury.name: Psychic Force
Fury.description: Psionic. Channel energy into your blades to damage nearby enemies and make your next bladesong unblockable.

Fury.name: Phantasmal Fury
Fury.description: Your phantasms have fury.

Fury.name: Master Fencer
Fury.description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike an enemy.

Fury.name: Time Sink
Fury.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, dazing and slowing their targets.

Fury.name: Chaos Vortex
Fury.description: Ambush. Release a vortex of chaos energy that inflicts damaging conditions on foes. Allies near you gain boons.  Clones using this attack grant their boons around you instead of themselves.

Fury.name: Bladesong Sorrow
Fury.description: Bladesong. Fire all stocked blades, inflicting your target with conditions.

Fury.name: Bladesong Dissonance
Fury.description: Bladesong. Combine all your blades into one large blade that dazes targets based on the number of blades consumed.

Fury.name: Duelist's Reversal
Fury.description: Blocking or dodging an attack grants boons.

Fury.name: Phantasmal Blades
Fury.description: Phantasms that successfully complete their attack launch a blade at their target and grant you fury when they expire.

Fury.name: Sharpening Sorrow
Fury.description: Gain fury when you activate Bladesong Sorrow. Fury increases your expertise.

Fury.name: Quiet Intensity
Fury.description: Fury gives an increased critical hit chance. Gain ferocity based on your vitality.

Fury.name: Deafening Drum
Fury.description: Instrument. Slam the drum to release a percussive shock wave, disabling enemies. The strength of the disable increases the closer an enemy is. The drum will then consume all notes to continue playing in the background. The drum's duration is extended for each note consumed.

Fury.name: Crescendo
Fury.description: Strike up the band and unleash a wave of sonic magic. Instruments playing in the background contribute to the amplitude, increasing the strength of the wave. This skill's recharge cannot be reset by other mesmer skills.

Fury.name: Desiccate
Fury.description: Punishment. Draw vital energy from your foes to gain life force and grant boons to nearby allies. Gain additional life force per target struck. Convert a boon on affected enemies to torment.

Fury.name: "Chilled to the Bone!"
Fury.description: Shout. Freeze all enemies around you, inflicting conditions on them. Gain boons for each foe you freeze. Deal additional damage and increased stun duration and gain additional boons when striking foes in melee range.

Fury.name: Furious Demise
Fury.description: Gain fury when entering shroud. Gain additional precision.

Fury.name: Sandstorm Shroud
Fury.description: Shade. Enter the final shroud, pulsing barrier to allies around yourself and priming the shroud for a powerful detonation that damages enemies and bolsters allies. Targets can only be affected by the detonation once per activation.

Fury.name: Desert Shroud
Fury.description: Shade. Enter the desert shroud, gaining a powerful barrier and pulsing necrotic energy around your sand shades. Targets affected by this ability can only be affected once per pulse.

Might.name: Wrathful Strike
Might.description: Attack with a final, powerful strike that applies might for each foe you strike.

Might.name: Gleaming Disc
Might.description: Spin around, striking enemies around you. After a short delay, a shock wave of light bursts forth from your position, damaging enemies and granting might to allies. Your next spear attack is illuminated when striking an enemy with the initial spin.   Illuminated. The shock wave additionally deals more damage and inflicts conditions on enemies and grants boons to allies.

Might.name: Symbol of Ignition
Might.description: Symbol. Create a symbol that ignites when you strike an enemy inside it or shoot a projectile into it, damaging and burning enemies inside it. If the symbol is ignited by a projectile, it enchants that projectile to burn its target.

Might.name: Symbol of Punishment
Might.description: Symbol. Create a symbol on the ground that strikes foes and grants might to nearby allies.

Might.name: Empower
Might.description: Channel healing and might to nearby allies. Completing this channel grants more health to your allies.

Might.name: Virtue of Justice
Might.description: Virtue: Burn foes every few attacks. Activate: You and your allies inflict burning on the next attack.

Might.name: "Save Yourselves!"
Might.description: Shout. Draw conditions from nearby allies to yourself. Gain multiple boons for a short duration.

Might.name: Dragon's Maw
Might.description: Trap. Lay a trap that pulls enemies and creates a barrier that holds them in.

Might.name: Righteous Instincts
Might.description: Resolution increases your chances to critically strike and grants might each interval.

Might.name: Might of the Protector
Might.description: Gain might when you block attacks.

Might.name: Empowering Might
Might.description: Grant might to nearby allies when you critically strike.

Might.name: Spear of Justice
Might.description: Virtue. Burn foes every few attacks. Activate: Hurl a spear of light that passes through foes. Enemies struck become tethered and receive conditions periodically.

Might.name: Tome of Justice
Might.description: Virtue: Burn foes every few attacks. Activate: Pull forth a magical tome on the dangers of the blazing heat in Kourna.

Might.name: Stoic Demeanor
Might.description: Retain Courage passive while it is on cooldown. Grant boons to nearby allies when you disable, immobilize, or slow an enemy.Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Might.name: Rushing Justice
Might.description: Virtue. Rush toward your target and gain Justice, delivering a strike and emanating Willbender Flames.

Might.name: Holy Reckoning
Might.description: Triggered virtue effects now grant might to allies in addition to their bonuses. Gain fury when activating Rushing Justice.

Might.name: Eviscerate
Might.description: Burst. Leap at your foe with a devastating attack.

Might.name: Keen Strike
Might.description: Chain. Strike your foe and gain might. Gain additional might on critical hit.

Might.name: Crushing Blow
Might.description: Crush your opponent's armor, leaving them vulnerable and gaining might. Vulnerability and might stacks doubled if you hit a disabled foe. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Might.name: Fierce Shot
Might.description: Fire a shot at your target. Gain might if you strike a vulnerable target.

Might.name: Valiant Leap
Might.description: Leap to the targeted location, empowering allies and damaging enemies. Gain adrenaline if you affect another ally.

Might.name: Signet of Might
Might.description: Signet Passive: Improves power. Signet Active: Attacks are unblockable and you gain might.

Might.name: "For Great Justice!"
Might.description: Shout. Grant fury and might to yourself and allies.

Might.name: Banner of Strength
Might.description: Banner. Place a banner that damages and dazes foes on initial placement, then pulses boons to you and nearby allies afterward.

Might.name: Frenzy
Might.description: Stance. Frenzy to gain quickness and might.

Might.name: "Find Their Weakness!"
Might.description: Command. Strike enemies around your target, inflicting vulnerability and spreading vulnerability from your original target to nearby enemies. Echo. Apply might to allies and gain adrenaline based on the number of enemies struck after a set interval or after you use a burst skill.

Might.name: Battle Standard
Might.description: Banner. Place a battle standard that revives fallen allies and finishes downed foes. Once placed, the banner periodically grants boons to allies.

Might.name: Signet of Rage
Might.description: Signet Passive: Grants adrenaline while in combat. Signet Active: Gain fury, might, and swiftness.

Might.name: Restorative Strength
Might.description: Using a heal skill grants might.

Might.name: Forceful Greatsword
Might.description: Gain power and a chance to gain might on critical strike. Double these bonuses while wielding a greatsword or underwater spear. Greatsword and underwater spear skills recharge faster.

Might.name: Aggressive Onslaught
Might.description: Gain quickness when you disable an enemy. While you have quickness, your movement speed is increased. This stacks with other movement speed increases.

Might.name: Marching Orders
Might.description: Periodically gain Soldier's Focus. Hitting with a burst skill expends Soldier's Focus to grant might to nearby allies.

Might.name: Empower Allies
Might.description: While you are in combat, grant might to yourself and nearby allies each interval.

Might.name: Phalanx Strength
Might.description: When you grant yourself might, grant it to nearby allies as well.

Might.name: Versatile Power
Might.description: Gain might on weapon swap. Burst skills gain reduced recharge.

Might.name: Decapitate
Might.description: Primal Burst. Gather your strength into a powerful attack. If it hits, gain might and recharge this skill.

Might.name: Heat the Soul
Might.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you hit an enemy with a Burst skill.

Might.name: Magebane Tether
Might.description: Tether yourself to your target. If they move beyond the range threshold, pull them to you. Grants might and reveals your target every second.

Might.name: River's Flow
Might.description: Load your gunsaber with ammunition that supports allies, changing its properties. Grant boons to nearby allies and gain positive flow when swapping to the gunsaber.

Might.name: Unyielding Dragon
Might.description: Dragon Slash becomes unblockable and ignores blindness. Gain might whenever you convert flow into charges.

Might.name: Daring Dragon
Might.description: Dragon Slash has a lower maximum charge level and consumes more flow per charge, but its effectiveness per charge is increased. Grant boons to nearby allies when you use Dragon Slash.

Might.name: Echoing Eruption
Might.description: Leap at your foe and deliver a massive attack that cascades outward.

Might.name: Acerbic Cut
Might.description: Slash at enemies again with Mists energy. Grant boons to allies after striking an enemy.

Might.name: Unrelenting Assault
Might.description: Shadowstep and unleash fierce attacks on nearby foes. Gain might each time you damage a foe.

Might.name: Empowering Misery
Might.description: Legendary Demon. Heal yourself. Gain might and heal more for each condition currently applied to you.

Might.name: Selfish Spirit
Might.description: Legendary Alliance. Channel your rage into the nearby area, healing and empowering yourself for each enemy struck.

Might.name: Facet of Strength
Might.description: Legendary Dragon. Facet. Place the Facet of Strength on yourself to grant nearby allies might every few seconds.

Might.name: Nomad's Advance
Might.description: Legendary Alliance. Lunge forward, damaging foes and gaining might for each target struck.

Might.name: Vicious Reprisal
Might.description: While you have resolution, all damage dealt is increased, and you gain might when you strike foes. Resolution granted to you lasts longer.

Might.name: Incensed Response
Might.description: Gain might when you grant yourself fury.

Might.name: Notoriety
Might.description: Might grants you more power and less condition damage. Gain might when using a legendary stance skill.

Might.name: Shared Empowerment
Might.description: When applying a boon to an ally, also apply might to nearby allies.

Might.name: Heroic Command
Might.description: Citadel Order. Refresh the duration of your Kalla's Fervor and grant nearby allies might for every stack.

Might.name: Ashen Demeanor
Might.description: Gain might, resistance, and Kalla's Fervor when you use a healing skill.

Might.name: Lasting Legacy
Might.description: Kalla's Fervor you inspire lasts longer and is more potent. Heroic Command grants more might per stack of Kalla's Fervor.

Might.name: Imperial Impact
Might.description: Drop from above, delivering a powerful attack to enemies while granting boons to allies.

Might.name: Amnesty of Shing Jea
Might.description: Legendary Alliance abilities gain an additional bonus. Activating Energy Meld or Alliance Tactics grants both of these bonuses simultaneously at greater amounts to nearby allies.Kurzick abilities grant regeneration.Luxon abilities grant might.

Might.name: Numinous Gift
Might.description: The third minor traits of other specializations you equip have improved effectiveness. Gain might and additional boons when you use Cosmic Wisdom, depending on which legends you have equipped.

Might.name: Found Purpose
Might.description: Trigger the active portion of Numinous Gift when you invoke a legend while in combat. Triggering Numinous Gift grants boons to allies in an area around you, depending on which legends you have equipped.

Might.name: Ricochet
Might.description: Bounce your axe between multiple foes, gaining might for each enemy struck.

Might.name: Precision Swipe
Might.description: Deliver a blow to your foe. Your pet gains might for each foe struck.

Might.name: Call of the Wild
Might.description: Daze and weaken nearby enemies. Grant fury, might, and swiftness to yourself and nearby allies.

Might.name: Smoke Assault
Might.description: Conceal yourself and lash out at nearby foes. Gain might each time you damage a foe.

Might.name: "We Heal As One!"
Might.description: Command. Heal yourself and your pet. You each gain copies of the other's boons.

Might.name: Sun Spirit
Might.description: Spirit. Summon a sun spirit at a target location and apply blindness to nearby enemies. The spirit will slam the ground and then shake, granting boons to nearby allies.

Might.name: "Guard!"
Might.description: Command. Order your pet to guard nearby allies; your pet takes damage on behalf of those allies. Gain might when your pet receives damage.

Might.name: Griffon Stance
Might.description: Stance. Evade and gain endurance. Your endurance recovery is greatly improved. You gain might and superspeed when you evade attacks. Evasion bonuses can occur once per interval.

Might.name: Vulture Stance
Might.description: Stance. While in this stance, striking a foe inflicts poison and grants you might. This effect can occur once per interval.

Might.name: "Strength of the Pack!"
Might.description: Command. Rampage with your pet, gaining stability, fury, and swiftness. You and your pet also grant might to each other when you attack.

Might.name: Stoneform
Might.description: Use Lesser Signet of Stone when you use an elite skill. Activating a Signet grants might and fury.

Might.name: Hunter's Gaze
Might.description: Gain might when you strike a foe based on their health percent.

Might.name: Strider's Strength
Might.description: You and your pet gain power. Gain additional power while wielding a sword. Successfully evading an attack grants might.

Might.name: Fortifying Bond
Might.description: When you gain a boon, it is shared with your pet.

Might.name: Spirited Arrival
Might.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when swapping pets.

Might.name: Bestial Rage
Might.description: Gain might and fury when you disable a foe.

Might.name: Grace of the Land
Might.description: Grant boons to allies within the radius of your Celestial Avatar skills.

Might.name: Fresh Reinforcement
Might.description: Entering beastmode grants you the boons affecting your pet.

Might.name: Let Loose
Might.description: Unleashed Ambush skills grant boons to nearby allies. Refresh Unleashed Power when you swap weapons.

Might.name: Hawkeye
Might.description: Release a hail of arrows toward your target and enemies nearby them.

Might.name: Unload
Might.description: Dual Wield. Blast your foe repeatedly with both pistols. Gain initiative if all attacks hit.

Might.name: Double Tap
Might.description: Fire two bullets that grant might if they hit your target.

Might.name: Shadow Sap
Might.description: Hurl a bolt of unfurling shadows to bolster allies.

Might.name: Consume Plasma
Might.description: Gain all boons.

Might.name: Well of Bounty
Might.description: Well. Shadowstep to a targeted point and create a well that grants boons to allies.

Might.name: Lotus Poison
Might.description: Gain might and weaken targets when you poison them.

Might.name: Assassin's Fury
Might.description: Gain might when you gain fury.

Might.name: Pumping Up
Might.description: Gain might when you dodge.

Might.name: Thrill of the Crime
Might.description: When you Steal, you and all nearby allies gain fury, might, and swiftness for 10 seconds.

Might.name: Bountiful Theft
Might.description: Stealing grants you and all nearby allies vigor. You rip boons from your target and grant them to nearby allies. Grant additional boons to allies if your target has no boons.

Might.name: Maleficent Seven
Might.description: Increase the maximum malice-stack count. Restore initiative and gain boons upon reaching the maximum number of malice stacks.

Might.name: Fire for Effect
Might.description: Using a stolen skill grants additional boons to allies around you. Stolen skills will always be Steal Time, regardless of the target's profession.

Might.name: Holo-Dancer Decoy
Might.description: Defensive Artifact. Summon a holo-dancer decoy that taunts enemies and grants boons to nearby allies. It self-destructs if it is not destroyed, dealing damage to enemies in a large area and granting additional boons to allies.  For a short time after using this skill, the next utility skill you use has reduced cooldown.

Might.name: Possessive Hoarder
Might.description: Artifacts grant boons to allies when used. Offensive and defensive artifacts grant different boons. Barrier granted through Magpie's Defense and Enterprising Aristocrat is now also granted to allies as well.

Might.name: Positive Strike
Might.description: Chain. Smack your hammer into your foe while empowering yourself.

Might.name: Equalizing Blow
Might.description: Chain. Bring down your hammer on your foe.

Might.name: Blunderbuss
Might.description: Fire several shards of shrapnel that inflict more damage the closer you are to foes. You and nearby allies gain might.

Might.name: Essence of Animated Sand
Might.description: Fire an arrow equipped with a payload that explodes enchanted sand on impact, granting barrier and might to allies.  Chain Reaction. The next short-bow skill in the radius will grant additional might to allies.

Might.name: Flame Turret
Might.description: Turret. Deploy a turret that burns foes. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first placed, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

Might.name: Elixir B
Might.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir B to gain fury, might, resolution, and swiftness, then extend the duration of boons on yourself.

Might.name: Blast Gyro
Might.description: Well. Unleash a blast gyro to begin a countdown to a tremendous blast.

Might.name: Sanguine Array
Might.description: Gain might when you inflict bleeding on a foe.

Might.name: Juggernaut
Might.description: Gain might while wielding a flamethrower. Might applied to you gains increased duration. Napalm grants you stability and a fire aura.

Might.name: Boiling Point
Might.description: Gain fury when you gain might at or above the threshold.

Might.name: HGH
Might.description: Elixirs gain increased durations and grant might.

Might.name: Chain Reactivity
Might.description: Gain barrier when you successfully finish a combo field with a leap or a blast. Every third successful finish grants you might and a larger barrier that is shared with allies.

Might.name: Mass Momentum
Might.description: Gain might while you have stability. Your Function Gyro applies stability to allies when cast.

Might.name: Kinetic Accelerators
Might.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you successfully combo a field with a blast, leap, or whirl finisher. Your function gyro is now a blast finisher.Whirl finishers can only trigger this trait once per interval.

Might.name: Applied Force
Might.description: Gain stability when you gain might at or above the threshold. Might grants bonus power.

Might.name: Enhanced Capacity Storage Unit
Might.description: Increases maximum heat capacity. While above 100% heat, periodically gain might. Some skills and traits gain additional heat tiers.

Might.name: Barrier Burst
Might.description: Mech Command. Pulse a barrier and boons to all nearby allies.  The mech does not count against the target count for this skill.

Might.name: Mech Arms: High-Impact Drivers
Might.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Explosive Knuckle. Your mech's attacks now generate might for allies within a radius. This effect may only occur once per interval.The mech does not count against the target count for this trait.

Might.name: Mech Frame: Channeling Conduits
Might.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Crisis Zone. When you or your mech apply barrier, also grant a boon to the affected target. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own concentration and healing power stats.

Might.name: New Genes
Might.description: Morph skills grant boons to allies. Grant an additional boon based on which morph skill was used.

Might.name: Fire Shield
Might.description: Envelop yourself in a fiery shield that burns foes and grants might each time you are struck (cooldown of 1 second per attacker).

Might.name: Molten End
Might.description: Slam your hammer into the ground, damaging nearby enemies. If this strikes a burning enemy, gain offensive boons.

Might.name: Seethe
Might.description: Gain boons. Your next spear skill deals increased damage.

Might.name: Etching: Volcano
Might.description: Etch a spell into the ground that creates a violent eruption. Using a number of other skills within this etching completes the spell, unlocking its full potential.

Might.name: Heat Sync
Might.description: Give might and fury to yourself, then spread boons you have to allies.

Might.name: Fire Attunement
Might.description: Attune to fire, gaining heavy damage and burning abilities.

Might.name: Glyph of Elemental Harmony
Might.description: Glyph. Heal yourself and gain a boon based on your attunement.

Might.name: Glyph of Elemental Power
Might.description: Glyph. Unleash elemental energy around yourself. Its effect will differ based on your attunement.

Might.name: Cleansing Fire
Might.description: Cantrip. Cure conditions and burn foes. Gain might for each condition removed.

Might.name: "Feel the Burn!"
Might.description: Shout. Heat waves blast out from the player, causing damage and granting fire aura to allies.

Might.name: Fervent Stance
Might.description: Stance. Gain quickness, fury, and swiftness. Gain might when you use a Dual Attack.

Might.name: Pyromancer's Puissance
Might.description: Gain might for using any skill while attuned to fire. When leaving fire attunement or successfully completing a fire overload, unleash a Flame Expulsion.

Might.name: Arcane Prowess
Might.description: Gain boons when you switch attunements.

Might.name: Overload Fire
Might.description: Overload. Unleash your flames, granting might to allies and burning enemies. Finishing the cast creates a tornado that continues to grant might and burn foes. Using this skill causes the attunement to have a longer recharge.

Might.name: Tempestuous Aria
Might.description: Using a shout grants allies might. Granting an aura to an ally increases your outgoing damage for a period of time.

Might.name: Lucid Singularity
Might.description: Apply boons to nearby allies while channeling overloads and when successfully completing an overload channel.

Might.name: Fire Sphere
Might.description: Throw your sphere, creating a combo field and granting boons to allies within range based on your active attunement.

Might.name: Vicious Empowerment
Might.description: Gain Elemental Empowerment and might when you disable or immobilize a foe.

Might.name: Energized Elements
Might.description: Gain energy and boons when you switch attunements. Energy can only be gained while in combat.

Might.name: Mirror Blade
Might.description: Throw an illusionary blade that creates a clone at its first target and then bounces to enemies and allies, dealing less damage to foes per bounce and granting might to allies.

Might.name: Psycut
Might.description: Slash your spear in front of yourself. Gain might per target struck.

Might.name: Psystrike
Might.description: Rend your foe with an upward swing. Gain might per target struck.

Might.name: Mind the Gap
Might.description: Swing your spear in a circle, dealing increased damage to foes in the outer edge. Striking with the outer edge will always deal a critical hit. Create a clone and gain Clarity if you hit an enemy. If you are empowered, gain might.

Might.name: Inspiring Imagery
Might.description: Throw an inspiring beacon to a target location. The beacon will explode after a short duration, granting boons to nearby allies. The beacon can be detonated early to heal allies and damage enemies.

Might.name: Tides of Time
Might.description: Grant boons to nearby allies as you launch a wave of temporal energy that damages and stops enemies it passes through, then returns to you. Touching the returning wave reduces the recharge of this skill.

Might.name: Winds of Chaos
Might.description: Bounce an orb of energy between foes and allies. The first hit applies torment, while subsequent hits to enemies apply confusion. Allies that the orb bounces to gain fury and might.

Might.name: Phantasmal Swordsman
Might.description: Phantasm. Perform a sword strike and create an illusion that attacks your foe. If the sword strike hits, you gain might.

Might.name: Siren's Call
Might.description: Unleash sonic energy that bounces between multiple foes, damaging and bleeding them. When it hits allies, it applies might, vigor, or swiftness.

Might.name: Mind Wrack
Might.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, damaging nearby foes. The shatter effect also occurs at your location.

Might.name: Signet of Inspiration
Might.description: Signet Passive: Grant swiftness and an additional random boon every ten seconds. Signet Active: Extends the duration of all boons on yourself.

Might.name: Mantra of Pain
Might.description: Mantra. Meditate, charging a spell that will damage your target. Grant might to nearby allies when this spell is fully charged.

Might.name: Well of Action
Might.description: Well. Create a well of delayed time, damaging and slowing foes. When the well expires, time snaps back, granting boons to allies.

Might.name: Psychic Force
Might.description: Psionic. Channel energy into your blades to damage nearby enemies and make your next bladesong unblockable.

Might.name: Furious Interruption
Might.description: Gain quickness when you interrupt a foe.

Might.name: Phantasmal Force
Might.description: Phantasms deal increased strike damage for each stack of might you have. Gain might when your phantasms become clones.

Might.name: Split Second
Might.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, damaging nearby foes. Strikes again after a delay. Shatter traits only affect the first strike of this skill.

Might.name: Stretched Time
Might.description: Nearby allies gain boons for each clone you shatter. Grant boons to nearby allies when you summon a phantasm.

Might.name: Split Surge
Might.description: Ambush. Shoot a beam at a targeted foe, and secondary beams at foes near your target.

Might.name: Chaos Vortex
Might.description: Ambush. Release a vortex of chaos energy that inflicts damaging conditions on foes. Allies near you gain boons.  Clones using this attack grant their boons around you instead of themselves.

Might.name: Bladesong Harmony
Might.description: Bladesong. Fire all stocked blades at your target.

Might.name: Lively Lute
Might.description: Instrument. Perform with your lute, sending out damaging sound waves toward an enemy and healing tones toward allies. The lute will then consume all notes to continue playing in the background. The lute's duration is extended for each note consumed.

Might.name: Crescendo
Might.description: Strike up the band and unleash a wave of sonic magic. Instruments playing in the background contribute to the amplitude, increasing the strength of the wave. This skill's recharge cannot be reset by other mesmer skills.

Might.name: Extirpate
Might.description: Perform a wide swing that removes boons from foes. Gain soul shards and might for each target struck.

Might.name: Oppressive Collapse
Might.description: Corrupt the ground under your target; if they remain within the area, they will be knocked down. Grant might to allies near your target based on how many conditions they have.

Might.name: Well of Power
Might.description: Well. Target area pulses, converting conditions on allies into boons and granting might.

Might.name: Blood Is Power
Might.description: Corruption. Bleed yourself to grant might to allies around you and bleed your target.

Might.name: "You Are All Weaklings!"
Might.description: Shout. Damage foes around you and gain boons. Inflict conditions on struck foes, and gain boons per foe struck. Deal additional damage and gain additional boons when striking foes within melee range.

Might.name: Desiccate
Might.description: Punishment. Draw vital energy from your foes to gain life force and grant boons to nearby allies. Gain additional life force per target struck. Convert a boon on affected enemies to torment.

Might.name: "Chilled to the Bone!"
Might.description: Shout. Freeze all enemies around you, inflicting conditions on them. Gain boons for each foe you freeze. Deal additional damage and increased stun duration and gain additional boons when striking foes in melee range.

Might.name: Ghastly Breach
Might.description: Punishment. Breach into the realm of torment for a brief time, granting might to allies and slowing enemies. Convert a boon on enemies into torment each pulse.

Might.name: Reaper's Might
Might.description: Shroud skill 1 grants might.

Might.name: Awaken the Pain
Might.description: Might grants you more power. Gain might when entering shroud.

Might.name: Siphoned Power
Might.description: Gain might when you strike a foe below the health threshold.

Might.name: Chilling Victory
Might.description: Striking a chilled foe grants might and life force.Single attacks can activate this trait more than once before recharging.

Might.name: Abrasive Grit
Might.description: Granting an ally a barrier removes conditions afflicting them and grants might.This effect only occurs with barrier from scourge skills and traits.

Might.name: Plague Blast
Might.description: Blast a foe with a plague that transfers one condition to them.

Protection.name: Symbol of Protection
Protection.description: Symbol. Smash a mystic symbol onto the ground that gives protection to you and your allies.

Protection.name: Protector's Strike
Protection.description: Protect allies from the next incoming attack against them, and lash out when attacked, granting boons to nearby allies and fully charging the passive burning effect.

Protection.name: Shield of Judgment
Protection.description: Create a shielding wave in front of you that damages foes while giving protection and aegis to you and up to five allies.

Protection.name: Virtue of Courage
Protection.description: Virtue: Gain aegis periodically. Activate: Grant aegis to yourself and nearby allies.

Protection.name: Resolute Stance
Protection.description: Stance. Enter a stance that heals when you remove conditions from yourself, then heal nearby allies and remove conditions from them.

Protection.name: Shield of the Avenger
Protection.description: Spirit Weapon. Command the Shield of the Avenger to form a protective dome, and then shatter, flying out to weaken nearby foes.

Protection.name: Signet of Judgment
Protection.description: Signet Passive: Reduces all incoming damage. Signet Active: Grant resolution and protection to nearby allies while debilitating nearby enemies.

Protection.name: "Save Yourselves!"
Protection.description: Shout. Draw conditions from nearby allies to yourself. Gain multiple boons for a short duration.

Protection.name: "Hold the Line!"
Protection.description: Shout. Grant protection and regeneration to allies.

Protection.name: Test of Faith
Protection.description: Trap. Lay a trap that creates a ring of weapons that punishes enemies that attempt to cross their threshold. Passthrough damage is increased against disabled targets.

Protection.name: Stalwart Stance
Protection.description: Stance. Break stun for nearby allies and enter a defensive stance, taking reduced damage.

Protection.name: Effulgent Stance
Protection.description: Stance. Grant barrier and light aura to nearby allies, then enter a stance that charges up a burst of light when striking or struck by enemies. The burst of light dazes enemies if fully charged.

Protection.name: Valorous Stance
Protection.description: Stance. Enter a stance that causes you to heal allies when you grant them boons, then grant boons to nearby allies.

Protection.name: Signet of Courage
Protection.description: Signet Passive: Periodically heal allies in an area around you while in combat. Signet Active: Channel healing and boons in a large area around you, concluding with a large heal if this skill is not interrupted.

Protection.name: Daring Advance
Protection.description: Stance. Leap to an area, tethering nearby enemies and empowering allies. Tethered enemies are revealed and take additional damage from your attacks and are stunned if they move beyond the range threshold.

Protection.name: Focus Mastery
Protection.description: Focus skills grant you protection and gain reduced recharge.

Protection.name: Steadfast Courage
Protection.description: Gain protection when you block an incoming attack with aegis.

Protection.name: Shield of Courage
Protection.description: Virtue. Grants aegis periodically. Activate: Grant aegis to nearby allies and create a shield in front of you that blocks attacks. You are vulnerable from the sides and behind while this shield is active.

Protection.name: Tome of Courage
Protection.description: Virtue: Gain aegis periodically.  Activate: Conjure a mystic tome containing stories about the heroes of Istan.

Protection.name: Vanguard Tactics
Protection.description: Activating Crashing Courage grants resistance. Shadowstepping grants resolution and protection.

Protection.name: Shimmering Stances
Protection.description: Stances grant protection to affected allies and blind affected enemies.

Protection.name: Line Breaker
Protection.description: Charge to the target location. When you arrive, heal nearby allies and grant them boons while debilitating nearby enemies.

Protection.name: Featherfoot Grace
Protection.description: Meditation. Gain a burst of superspeed and resistance.

Protection.name: "Brace Yourselves!"
Protection.description: Command. Apply barrier to yourself and allies around you.  Echo.  Apply barrier again to allies after a set interval or after you use a burst skill.

Protection.name: Thick Skin
Protection.description: Gain protection when you use a healing skill.

Protection.name: Soldier's Comfort
Protection.description: Soldier's Focus heals affected allies and grants them protection.

Protection.name: Guard Counter
Protection.description: Gain protection after a successful Full Counter.

Protection.name: Dragonscale Defense
Protection.description: Gain boons when entering Dragon Trigger.

Protection.name: Immortal Dragon
Protection.description: Dragon Slash heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt. Grant protection to allies whenever you convert a certain amount of flow into charges.

Protection.name: Envoy of Exuberance
Protection.description: Send the energy of Glint toward the target area, releasing a burst of energy that heals allies and grants boons.

Protection.name: Rift of Pain
