Stability.description: Cantrip. Gain stability and shape-shift into a tornado that damages and launches foes.

Stability.name: "Rebound!"
Stability.description: Shout. Shout and infuse your allies with arcane energy. Allies who would take lethal damage while this is active ignore the deathblow and are healed instead. If the effect expires naturally, grant an aura based on your current attunement.

Stability.name: Rock Solid
Stability.description: Grant stability to nearby allies when attuning to earth. Note: This effect will not trigger when attuning to the same element.

Stability.name: Overload Earth
Stability.description: Overload. Ride your stored earth magic around, granting protection to other allies you move over and crippling enemies, then deliver a final immobilizing blast of power to the area, leaving behind a dust cyclone that delivers the same effects as the overload. Using this skill causes the attunement to have a longer recharge.

Stability.name: Harmonious Conduit
Stability.description: Gain stability and swiftness when starting an overload.

Stability.name: Signet of Inspiration
Stability.description: Signet Passive: Grant swiftness and an additional random boon every ten seconds. Signet Active: Extends the duration of all boons on yourself.

Stability.name: Mantra of Concentration
Stability.description: Mantra. Meditate, charging a spell that will break stuns and grant stability to nearby allies. Grant boons to nearby allies when this spell fully charges.

Stability.name: Well of Precognition
Stability.description: Well. Create a well that gives allies the ability to see the future, allowing them to block incoming attacks. When the well ends, allies within the well regain endurance.

Stability.name: Bountiful Disillusionment
Stability.description: Gain stability when you use a Shatter skill. Grant an additional boon to nearby allies based on which Shatter is used.

Stability.name: Continuum Split
Stability.description: Destroy all your clones and create a rift in the space-time continuum. When it expires, you will revert back to your original point with your previous health, endurance, and skill recharges. Duration increases with each illusion shattered. This skill's recharge cannot be reset by other mesmer skills.

Stability.name: Bladeturn Requiem
Stability.description: Bladesong.Send your blades spinning around you to hit nearby foes. Spinning blade duration scales with number of blades consumed.

Stability.name: Crescendo
Stability.description: Strike up the band and unleash a wave of sonic magic. Instruments playing in the background contribute to the amplitude, increasing the strength of the wave. This skill's recharge cannot be reset by other mesmer skills.

Stability.name: Reaper's Mark
Stability.description: Mark. Inscribe a mark that inflicts fear on foes when triggered.

Stability.name: Well of Power
Stability.description: Well. Target area pulses, converting conditions on allies into boons and granting might.

Stability.name: Trail of Anguish
Stability.description: Punishment. Leave a trail of sand as you travel. Grant boons to allies passing through it. Inflict burning on enemies and corrupt a boon into torment.

Stability.name: Lich Form
Stability.description: Spectral. Assume the form of a lich for a brief time, improving your precision and vitality. Gain life force when this skill ends. Entering this form removes other spectral effects.

Stability.name: "Chilled to the Bone!"
Stability.description: Shout. Freeze all enemies around you, inflicting conditions on them. Gain boons for each foe you freeze. Deal additional damage and increased stun duration and gain additional boons when striking foes in melee range.

Stability.name: Xinrae's Weapon
Stability.description: Weapon spell. When you take damage over a percentage of your maximum health, heal for the difference, then steal life from that foe. Grant fewer stacks of this to nearby allies and break them out of stuns.

Stability.name: Infusing Terror
Stability.description: Shroud. Shroud yourself with dark armor that grants stability and reduces incoming damage. While the armor is active, you may reactivate this skill to inflict fear on foes around you.

Stability.name: Implacable Foe
Stability.description: Gain stability and damage reduction when entering Harbinger Shroud. Gain ferocity based on your vitality.

Swiftness.name: Symbol of Swiftness
Swiftness.description: Symbol. Sear a mystic symbol into the target area, damaging foes and granting swiftness to allies. Allies in the area gain a burst of speed when the symbol is created.

Swiftness.name: "Advance!"
Swiftness.description: Shout. Grant aegis and swiftness to up to five nearby allies.

Swiftness.name: "Save Yourselves!"
Swiftness.description: Shout. Draw conditions from nearby allies to yourself. Gain multiple boons for a short duration.

Swiftness.name: Light's Judgment
Swiftness.description: Trap. Lay down a trap that creates an area of pure light that reveals enemies and pierces their armor. The first strike dazes foes.

Swiftness.name: Righteous Sprint
Swiftness.description: Gain increased movement speed. Gain swiftness when you activate a virtue.

Swiftness.name: Charge
Swiftness.description: Grant boons and remove movement-impairing conditions from allies.

Swiftness.name: Balanced Stance
Swiftness.description: Stance. Gain stability and swiftness on an interval. Become immune to critical hits.

Swiftness.name: Battle Standard
Swiftness.description: Banner. Place a battle standard that revives fallen allies and finishes downed foes. Once placed, the banner periodically grants boons to allies.

Swiftness.name: Signet of Rage
Swiftness.description: Signet Passive: Grants adrenaline while in combat. Signet Active: Gain fury, might, and swiftness.

Swiftness.name: Rampage
Swiftness.description: Physical. Take the form of a massive juggernaut, reducing the damage you take and the duration of incoming movement-impeding conditions.

Swiftness.name: Fast Hands
Swiftness.description: Gain swiftness when swapping weapons in combat.

Swiftness.name: Burst Mastery
Swiftness.description: Burst skills deal more damage, grant swiftness, and restore a portion of adrenaline spent.

Swiftness.name: Facet of Elements
Swiftness.description: Legendary Dragon. Facet. Place the Facet of Elements on yourself to grant nearby allies swiftness every few seconds.

Swiftness.name: Rapid Flow
Swiftness.description: Heal yourself and gain swiftness when you use a skill that has an energy cost.

Swiftness.name: Heroic Command
Swiftness.description: Citadel Order. Refresh the duration of your Kalla's Fervor and grant nearby allies might for every stack.

Swiftness.name: Shared Wisdom
Swiftness.description: Grant boons to allies whenever you use a Legendary Entity Skill, depending on which skill was used.

Swiftness.name: Cheetah's Strike
Swiftness.description: Chain. Heave your spear, gaining swiftness if you strike an enemy. If your enemy is far away, use Bee's Sting instead.

Swiftness.name: Panther's Prowl
Swiftness.description: Conceal yourself in the brush, gaining stealth. Gain Hunter's Prowess, allowing you to use a Stealth Attack even if revealed.

Swiftness.name: Hunter's Shot
Swiftness.description: Fire an arrow that grants you stealth when it hits an enemy. Your pet gains swiftness.

Swiftness.name: Point-Blank Shot
Swiftness.description: Push back your foe with a point-blank shot. The closer they are, the farther it pushes them back.

Swiftness.name: Quick Shot
Swiftness.description: Fire a quick shot in an evasive retreat. Gain swiftness. This can be used while retreating.

Swiftness.name: Call of the Wild
Swiftness.description: Daze and weaken nearby enemies. Grant fury, might, and swiftness to yourself and nearby allies.

Swiftness.name: Quickening Screech
Swiftness.description: Grant swiftness to nearby allies and remove movement-impairing conditions from them.

Swiftness.name: "We Heal As One!"
Swiftness.description: Command. Heal yourself and your pet. You each gain copies of the other's boons.

Swiftness.name: Moa Stance
Swiftness.description: Stance. Gain boons. Increase the duration of boons you grant while in this stance.

Swiftness.name: "Strength of the Pack!"
Swiftness.description: Command. Rampage with your pet, gaining stability, fury, and swiftness. You and your pet also grant might to each other when you attack.

Swiftness.name: Lead the Wind
Swiftness.description: Your longbow and harpoon-gun skills pierce and recharge faster. Point-Blank Shot grants boons.

Swiftness.name: Tail Wind
Swiftness.description: Gain swiftness when swapping weapons in combat.

Swiftness.name: Fortifying Bond
Swiftness.description: When you gain a boon, it is shared with your pet.

Swiftness.name: Fresh Reinforcement
Swiftness.description: Entering beastmode grants you the boons affecting your pet.

Swiftness.name: Feel the Rush
Swiftness.description: Movement skills grant you swiftness and endurance.

Swiftness.name: Skirmisher's Shot
Swiftness.description: Fire a bullet that inflicts conditions on your target and grants you a boon.

Swiftness.name: Infiltrator's Strike
Swiftness.description: Shadowstep to a foe and strike them. Use Shadow Return to shadowstep back and cure one condition.

Swiftness.name: Consume Plasma
Swiftness.description: Gain all boons.

Swiftness.name: Signet of Shadows
Swiftness.description: Signet Passive: Grants a 25% increase in movement speed. Signet Active: Gain stealth and swiftness. Remove all movement-impairing conditions from yourself.

Swiftness.name: Haste
Swiftness.description: Trick. Gain quickness, fury, and swiftness.

Swiftness.name: Expeditious Dodger
Swiftness.description: Gain swiftness upon dodging.

Swiftness.name: Thrill of the Crime
Swiftness.description: When you Steal, you and all nearby allies gain fury, might, and swiftness for 10 seconds.

Swiftness.name: Dash
Swiftness.description: Remove conditions and gain swiftness, then rush forward and evade attacks.

Swiftness.name: Maleficent Seven
Swiftness.description: Increase the maximum malice-stack count. Restore initiative and gain boons upon reaching the maximum number of malice stacks.

Swiftness.name: Elixir H
Swiftness.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir H to heal yourself and gain protection, regeneration, and swiftness.

Swiftness.name: Net Turret
Swiftness.description: Turret. Build a net turret that immobilizes nearby foes. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first placed, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

Swiftness.name: Elixir B
Swiftness.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir B to gain fury, might, resolution, and swiftness, then extend the duration of boons on yourself.

Swiftness.name: Streamlined Kits
Swiftness.description: Equipping an Engineering Kit creates an attack or spell and grants you swiftness.

Swiftness.name: Object in Motion
Swiftness.description: Deal increased strike damage while you have stability, swiftness, or superspeed. This damage increase compounds for each boon you have.

Swiftness.name: Updraft
Swiftness.description: Gain swiftness from a gust of wind that launches nearby foes.

Swiftness.name: Windborne Speed
Swiftness.description: You and nearby allies gain swiftness, while curing crippled, immobilized, and chilled.

Swiftness.name: Air Attunement
Swiftness.description: Attune to air, gaining heavy damage and control abilities.

Swiftness.name: Glyph of Elemental Harmony
Swiftness.description: Glyph. Heal yourself and gain a boon based on your attunement.

Swiftness.name: Glyph of Elemental Power
Swiftness.description: Glyph. Unleash elemental energy around yourself. Its effect will differ based on your attunement.

Swiftness.name: "Eye of the Storm!"
Swiftness.description: Shout. Imbue your voice with the element of air, massively increasing speed and breaking stun for nearby allies.

Swiftness.name: Zephyr's Boon
Swiftness.description: Grant boons to allies you grant auras to.

Swiftness.name: Harmonious Conduit
Swiftness.description: Gain stability and swiftness when starting an overload.

Swiftness.name: Elemental Pursuit
Swiftness.description: Swiftness on you is improved. Gain swiftness when you disable an enemy. Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

Swiftness.name: Deploy Jade Sphere
Swiftness.description: Summon your jade sphere, creating a combo field and granting boons to allies in its radius based on its element.

Swiftness.name: Spectacular Sphere
Swiftness.description: Your jade sphere is larger and grants quickness and an additional boon based on your current attunement to nearby allies when activated.

Swiftness.name: Temporal Curtain
Swiftness.description: Create a wall of energy that grants swiftness to allies who cross it and cripples foes who touch it. Allies may cross the wall more than once but receive less swiftness after the first crossing.

Swiftness.name: Phantasmal Lancer
Swiftness.description: Dash at your foe, removing boons from them. Leave a phantasm at your initial location that will launch a spear at your target, dealing heavy damage and crippling targets. If your phantasm strikes a crippled target, immobilize them instead. If you have Clarity, summon an additional phantasm.

Swiftness.name: Tides of Time
Swiftness.description: Grant boons to nearby allies as you launch a wave of temporal energy that damages and stops enemies it passes through, then returns to you. Touching the returning wave reduces the recharge of this skill.

Swiftness.name: Chaos Armor
Swiftness.description: Blind and confuse nearby foes while you gain chaos aura. Chaos aura grants you a random boon and inflicts your foe with a random condition whenever you are struck.

Swiftness.name: Chaos Storm
Swiftness.description: Create a magical storm at the target location that applies random conditions to foes and boons to allies. The first strike of the storm dazes foes.

Swiftness.name: Siren's Call
Swiftness.description: Unleash sonic energy that bounces between multiple foes, damaging and bleeding them. When it hits allies, it applies might, vigor, or swiftness.

Swiftness.name: Signet of Inspiration
Swiftness.description: Signet Passive: Grant swiftness and an additional random boon every ten seconds. Signet Active: Extends the duration of all boons on yourself.

Swiftness.name: Wandering Mind
Swiftness.description: Remove a nondamaging condition and gain swiftness whenever you evade an attack.

Swiftness.name: Deadly Feast
Swiftness.description: Gain swiftness and summon a swarm of vampiric shrimp that siphon health from nearby foes.

Swiftness.name: Locust Swarm
Swiftness.description: Grant swiftness to allies and summon a swarm of locusts that siphons health to you and your allies from nearby foes.

Swiftness.name: Spectral Walk
Swiftness.description: Spectral. Create a shadowy tether and become spectral, consuming conditions for life force. You may return to your initial position by using Spectral Recall.

Swiftness.name: Trail of Anguish
Swiftness.description: Punishment. Leave a trail of sand as you travel. Grant boons to allies passing through it. Inflict burning on enemies and corrupt a boon into torment.

Swiftness.name: Speed of Shadows
Swiftness.description: Entering shroud grants swiftness and removes movement-impairing conditions.

Vigor.name: Symbol of Energy
Vigor.description: Symbol. Fire a slow, arcing arrow that explodes on impact to burn targets and sear a symbol of energy into the ground.

Vigor.name: "Save Yourselves!"
Vigor.description: Shout. Draw conditions from nearby allies to yourself. Gain multiple boons for a short duration.

Vigor.name: Vigorous Precision
Vigor.description: Gain vigor at the end of your dodge roll.

Vigor.name: Restorative Virtues
Vigor.description: Triggered virtue effects reduce the cooldown of active weapon abilities. Gain vigor when activating Flowing Resolve.

Vigor.name: Call of Valor
Vigor.description: Removes conditions from allies and grants them vigor. Affected targets also gain barrier.

Vigor.name: Combat Stimulant
Vigor.description: Armament. Heal yourself and enter Stim State. When Stim State expires, you are healed again. Using this skill while in Stim State grants boons.

Vigor.name: Last Stand
Vigor.description: Stances grant vigor and barrier when activated, and they have increased duration.

Vigor.name: Unwavering Avoidance
Vigor.description: Gain vigor when successfully evading an attack.

Vigor.name: Elevated Compassion
Vigor.description: Heal allies when you grant them boons. Grant boons to allies when your upkeep cost is equal to or higher than the threshold.An ally can only be affected by this skill once per interval.

Vigor.name: Brutal Momentum
Vigor.description: Gain increased critical-hit chance. This bonus is increased further while your endurance is full. Gain vigor when you gain fury.

Vigor.name: Song of Arboreum
Vigor.description: Energy Meld grants more endurance and grants its endurance and vigor to nearby allies.

Vigor.name: Cultivate
Vigor.description: Swing an uppercut at your target, crippling them and granting vigor to nearby allies. Gain Nature's Strength if you hit an enemy.  This skill cannot activate Force of Nature.

Vigor.name: Pounce
Vigor.description: Deliver a leaping strike that deals more damage to disabled, defiant, or movement-impaired foes. Gain vigor if an enemy is struck.

Vigor.name: "We Heal As One!"
Vigor.description: Command. Heal yourself and your pet. You each gain copies of the other's boons.

Vigor.name: Water Spirit
Vigor.description: Spirit. Summon a water spirit at a target location and heal yourself and your pet. The spirit will slam the ground and then shake, granting boons to nearby allies.

Vigor.name: Lightning Reflexes
Vigor.description: Survival. Evade back with a crack of lightning, dealing damage and gaining vigor.

Vigor.name: Primal Reflexes
Vigor.description: When you successfully evade an attack, gain vigor.

Vigor.name: Fortifying Bond
Vigor.description: When you gain a boon, it is shared with your pet.

Vigor.name: Invigorating Bond
Vigor.description: Beast skills heal allies around the ranger.

Vigor.name: Fresh Reinforcement
Vigor.description: Entering beastmode grants you the boons affecting your pet.

Vigor.name: Consume Plasma
Vigor.description: Gain all boons.

Vigor.name: Well of Bounty
Vigor.description: Well. Shadowstep to a targeted point and create a well that grants boons to allies.

Vigor.name: Feline Grace
Vigor.description: Gain vigor upon successfully evading an attack.

Vigor.name: Bountiful Theft
Vigor.description: Stealing grants you and all nearby allies vigor. You rip boons from your target and grant them to nearby allies. Grant additional boons to allies if your target has no boons.

Vigor.name: Maleficent Seven
Vigor.description: Increase the maximum malice-stack count. Restore initiative and gain boons upon reaching the maximum number of malice stacks.

Vigor.name: Energizing Slam
Vigor.description: Leap forward and smash the ground, inflicting conditions on foes while granting barrier and boons to allies.

Vigor.name: Healing Turret
Vigor.description: Turret. Deploy a turret that heals you briefly, then regenerates you and your allies. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first dropped, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

Vigor.name: Elixir U
Vigor.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir U, gaining quickness, stability, and vigor.

Vigor.name: Invigorating Speed
Vigor.description: When you gain swiftness or superspeed, you also gain vigor.

Vigor.name: Optimized Activation
Vigor.description: Using tool belt skills grants vigor.

Vigor.name: Thermal Release Valve
Vigor.description: Dodge rolling vents heat as an attack against nearby foes and grants vigor.(Attack will not occur without heat.)

Vigor.name: Phoenix
Vigor.description: Release a fiery phoenix that attacks foes in a line before exploding and returning to you, curing a condition and granting you vigor. Inflict additional burning against foes that are already burning.

Vigor.name: Heat Wave
Vigor.description: Launch three waves of heat. Each burns foes and grants vigor to allies.

Vigor.name: Ether Renewal
Vigor.description: Cantrip. Cure a condition and heal yourself with every pulse.

Vigor.name: Renewing Stamina
Vigor.description: Gain vigor when you critically strike a foe.

Vigor.name: Overload Water
Vigor.description: Overload. Create a surge of accumulated water magic, healing and cleansing allies. When the cast ends, heal the area and apply regeneration. Using this skill causes the attunement to have a longer recharge.

Vigor.name: Latent Stamina
Vigor.description: Grant vigor to nearby allies when attuning to water. Restore endurance to allies you grant vigor.

Vigor.name: Invigorating Torrents
Vigor.description: Auras you grant also grant regeneration and vigor.

Vigor.name: Evasive Empowerment
Vigor.description: Gain Elemental Empowerment and vigor when evading an attack.

Vigor.name: Siren's Call
Vigor.description: Unleash sonic energy that bounces between multiple foes, damaging and bleeding them. When it hits allies, it applies might, vigor, or swiftness.

Vigor.name: Cry of Frustration
Vigor.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, confusing nearby foes. The shatter effect also occurs at your location.

Vigor.name: False Oasis
Vigor.description: Deception. Create a mirage at your current location and heal over time. When the mirage expires, it spawns a mirage mirror.

Vigor.name: Twin Blade Restoration
Vigor.description: Psionic. Heal yourself, lose conditions, and throw two blades at your target. If the first blade hits, you gain aegis. If the second blade hits, you gain vigor.

Vigor.name: Signet of Inspiration
Vigor.description: Signet Passive: Grant swiftness and an additional random boon every ten seconds. Signet Active: Extends the duration of all boons on yourself.

Vigor.name: Critical Infusion
Vigor.description: Gain vigor when delivering a critical hit.

Vigor.name: Mental Gymnastics
Vigor.description: When you successfully evade an attack, gain vigor.

Vigor.name: Rewinder
Vigor.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, confusing nearby foes and recharging this skill for each clone shattered.

Vigor.name: Nomad's Endurance
Vigor.description: Shatter skills give vigor. Strike and condition damage dealt is increased when you have vigor.

Vigor.name: Mirage Mantle
Vigor.description: Ambush skills you use grant boons to nearby allies.

Vigor.name: Bladesong Sorrow
Vigor.description: Bladesong. Fire all stocked blades, inflicting your target with conditions.

Vigor.name: Flustering Flute
Vigor.description: Instrument. Play an enchanting tune with the flute, confusing enemies in front of you. Enemies in the center of the music will be dazed. The flute will then consume all notes to continue playing in the background. The flute's duration is extended for each note consumed.

Vigor.name: Mark of Blood
Vigor.description: Mark. Inscribe a mark that bleeds foes when they trigger it, and grants regeneration to allies.

Vigor.name: Desert Empowerment
Vigor.description: Manifest Sand Shade grants a barrier to allies near it. When you apply barrier, grant boons to the affected target.This effect only occurs with barrier from scourge skills and traits.

Vigor.name: Empowering Spirits
Vigor.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you summon a spirit.
